title: Quasimodular Forms, Partitions, and Primes in Intervals
summary: Recent developments in theories of partitions, quasimodular forms, multiple zeta values and $q$-multiple zeta values have led to connections between partitions and primes. Central to this progress are prime-detecting quasimodular forms, which are $q$-series whose non-negative coefficients vanish if and only if the input is prime. In this paper, we use properties of these quasimodular forms to motivate a proof of the infinitude of primes, to construct a novel partition theoretic factorization algorithm, and to show that the distribution of these coefficients relate to existence of primes in…
